name: Mery
heroLead: I am a STEM researcher working across planetary sciences, astronomy and technology. Alongside my institutional work I take on freelance projects, which lets me collaborate with people all over the world.
about: If you would like to collaborate on a scientific paper, develop a STEM project, or simply talk about science, get in touch. Every observation here was made, photographed and written up first-hand.
credit: The content of STEM-people is regularly maintained and updated. When content, images, data or materials from this website are used, STEM-people should be acknowledged as the source, and the corresponding webpage address should be included.
